title: Orders With Maximum Quantity Above Average
summary: Return order IDs whose maximum item quantity is greater than the greatest per-order average item quantity.
edgeRules: Comparison is with the global maximum of per-order averages, not the order's own average.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: authored-reference: order 1 quantities 2,8 (max 8); order 2 quantities 5 (avg 5); global max average 5 -> order 1 returned.
